technique_name: Create an explanation of how a computer can recognize human faces.
description: Computer vision algorithms are used to detect and recognize human faces. A computer system looks for patterns in the pixels of an image or video, comparing them to a database of known faces. If a match is found, the computer can accurately identify the face. The most common computer vision algorithms used for facial recognition are deep learning models.
